results.raw_content: [Back to Search Programs](/search) # Master Informatique — Applications interactives et données numériques (AIDN) [Université Bretagne Sud](/university/universite-bretagne-sud) Lorient, France2 yearsTaught in FrenchOpen to international students ## About Master Informatique — Applications interactives et données numériques (AIDN) Tuition fees for Master Informatique — Applications interactives et données numériques (AIDN) are 250 EUR per year. Université Bretagne Sud in Vannes offers the Master Informatique — Applications interactives et données numériques (AIDN), a two-year master's program taught in French. The specialization named in the program title points to two connected areas within computer science: the design of interactive software systems and the management and use of digital data. Interactive applications concern how users engage with software through interfaces, whether on desktop, web, or mobile platforms, and study covers topics such as user interface design, human-computer interaction principles, usability testing, and front-end and back-end development. The digital data component typically brings in database design, data structures, data processing pipelines, and methods for storing, querying, and visualizing information at scale. Students pursuing this combination often work on projects that require building an application from a functioning interface layer through to the data infrastructure that supports it, giving them exposure to full software development cycles. Related subjects frequently include web technologies, software architecture, algorithms, and increasingly data-driven techniques such as basic statistical analysis or exploratory data science applied within software products. Because interactive systems and data management intersect with many industries, graduates in this discipline find opportunities as software developers, full-stack engineers, user interface or user experience specialists, database administrators, and data analysts. Some go on to specialize further in fields such as data engineering or human-computer interaction research. The AIDN program runs over two years, begins in September, and is delivered in French at the Vannes campus of Université Bretagne Sud. The annual tuition for the program is 250 EUR. Nowadays there are also take away meals ordered and delivered at home. People usually have bottled or tap water and or wine with their meal. Grocery Food is usually cheaper in supermarkets and fresh food at the weekly open markets. Most well-known supermarkets include Carrefour, Intermarché, Leclerc, Aldi, Auchan, Lidl, Super U, Géant Casino. Check out the fresh food markets as they are usually a nice outing, and prices are cheaper towards the end of the market. In Lorient the fresh food markets are on Wednesday and Saturday mornings at the Merville hall in the city centre from 8 am to 1 pm. In Vannes, the market takes place on Wednesday and on Saturday mornings. In Pontivy, the fresh food market is rue Lorois on Saturdays from 8 am to 1 pm. Organic shops also exist and are becoming common place but tend to be more expensive. Try to find a local organic cooperative producer selling local produce, if you want organic food, they may have less choice but are cheaper.
